name: Bilibili Resolver
description: Turn Bilibili video page links (BV/av/b23.tv) into downloadable MP4 URLs, with your preferred quality and optional login cookie.
settings.title: Bilibili Resolver
settings.enabled.title: Enabled
settings.enabled.desc: Resolve Bilibili video links before the download starts.
settings.preferredQuality.title: Preferred quality
settings.preferredQuality.desc: Defaults to Highest: select the highest resolution actually returned, without a resolution or QN ceiling. Specific qualities retain their ceiling. DASH needs host merging; highest needs the updated media-protocol host.
settings.cookie.title: Login cookie
settings.cookie.desc: Optional. Paste SESSDATA or a full Cookie header for account-authorized quality; progressive 1080P is not guaranteed. Stored locally and sent by the resolver only to api.bilibili.com.
settings.showSinglePartDialog.title: Show selection dialog for single-part videos
settings.showSinglePartDialog.desc: When enabled, choose quality before downloading a single-part video. When disabled, download at the preferred quality directly. Multipart videos always show the selection dialog. Requires a compatible host.
